title: The Brass Band of the Balloon Fair
description: At the autumn balloon fair, the wind plays a tuba, trumpet, and horn high above the orchard. The crowd listens from the hillside, where the low notes arrive first.
alt: A large tuba hangs from a blue-and-cream balloon over an autumn field. Two distant balloons carry a trumpet and a horn as people watch from a picnic blanket.
pairing: An autumn balloon fair × a brass band played by the wind
